carpet.rule.maxPlayerBotCap.desc: Controls how many bots can player spawn without [carpet.unlimitedBots] permission.
carpet.rule.maxPlayerBotGlobalCap.desc: Controls how many bots can be spawned without [carpet.ignoreGlobalBotCap] permission.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerLuckPermsGroup.des: The LuckPerms group to assign to spawned fake players.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerRemoveDefaultGroup: Whether to remove the default group from the fake player if another group is assigned.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerDefaultPrivate.des: Whether fake players are spawned as private by default.
carpet.rule.playerCommandBlockBotVerific: If BlockBot is installed, prevents non-ops from spawning fake players with names of whitelisted/linked players.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerXpDropFix.desc: Clears fake player experience when killed to prevent XP duping.
carpet.rule.disablePlayerJoinAsBot.desc: Prevents real players from joining with the name of an active bot.
carpet.rule.botNamePrefix.desc: Prefix to strip from bot names when checking whitelist permissions.
carpet.rule.botNameSuffix.desc: Suffix to strip from bot names when checking whitelist permissions.
carpet.rule.fakePlayerBlockInteractionDi: Comma, space, or semicolon separated block ids that fake players must not interact with; blocked interactions are silently skipped.
